φῆμις: φῆμις — report, talk, rumour; fem. nom. sg.

__broaden__.αἰγύπτῳ: Αἴγυπτος — Egypt; fem. dat. sg., poetic dat. of direction: ‘to Egypt’ · also a plain dative of place where, ’in Egypt’ (Αἰγύπτῳ ... ἔσχον ’the gods held me back in Egypt’) · also Αἴγυπτος, masc., the river Nile; dat. sg., with ποταμῷ in apposition: ’in the river Egypt’
__broaden__.αἰδοῖός: αἰδοῖος — worthy of respect, reverend, august; masc. nom. sg., predicate adj. agreeing with the implied ’you’ (subject of εἰλήλουθας), not itself a vocative form: ’honored’ · also masc. nom. sg., predicate adj. agreeing with a first-person subject: ’revered’ (δεινός τ’ αἰδοῖός τε … τετύγμην)
__broaden__.γένος: γένος — stock, race, lineage, offspring; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., governed by μετά: ’after (blood and) lineage’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of εὔχομαι: ’descent, birth’ (γένος εὔχομαι ’I declare my birth’)
__broaden__.εἰσορόωντα: εἰσοράω — look upon, gaze at; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶντα): ’as I gaze’, agreeing with an implied ’me’ · also agreeing with σ’ (σε), ’you looking at’
__broaden__.εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’) · also with opt., of an aim in view: ’in case, to see if’ (εἴ τινά … λάβοι ’in case he might catch someone’) · also in ὡς εἴ τ’ + opt., ’as if’ · also in ὡς εἴ τε with no verb or optative expressed: ’as if’
__broaden__.ζωὴν: ζωός — alive, living; fem. acc. sg., predicative: ’alive’ · also ζωή — life; fem. acc. sg. · also ζωή — livelihood, means of living, substance; fem. acc. sg.: ’the estate’ (ζωὴν ἐδάσαντο ’divided the livelihood’)
__broaden__.λάγχανον: λαγχάνω — obtain by lot, receive as one’s share; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐλάγχανον): ’fell to (each ship)’ · also impf. 1 sg. (the same form): ’I received as my share’
__broaden__.μεῖναι: μένω — stay, wait; aor. inf., standing as an instruction: ’wait’ · also infinitive after χρεώ, ’to wait’ (οὐ χρεὼ … ἀλλ’ … μεῖναι ’no need … but to wait’) · also aor. inf. after ὄφελον, an unfulfillable wish: ’would that I had stayed’ · also aor. inf. complementing ἔτλη: ’to stand firm, to face’ (οὐδέ τις ἔτλη μεῖναι ’nor did any dare to stand’)
__broaden__.μέσσον: μέσος — middle, in the middle; neut. acc. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic μέσον), used as a noun: ’the middle’ · also adverbial neut. acc. sg.: ’midway’ (μέσσον ὑπὲρ Κρήτης ’midway over Crete’)
__broaden__.πῆμ: πῆμα — woe, calamity; neut. acc. sg., elided (πῆμ’ = πῆμα) · also neut. nom. sg., elided (πῆμ’ = πῆμα), subject: ’woe’ (πῆμ’ ὑπέδεκτο ’woe awaited’)
__broaden__.ὑπέδεκτο: ὑποδέχομαι — undertake, promise, agree to; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented · also ’receive as a host, welcome’ (ὅττι μιν ὣς ὑπέδεκτο ’that he had received him so’) · also ’await, lie in wait for’, of woe awaiting a man (ἔτι γάρ νύ με πῆμ’ ὑπέδεκτο ’for woe still awaited me’); the form is in fact augmented (ὑπ-έ-δεκτο, 2nd aor.)
__broaden__.φίλ: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. voc. sg., elided (φίλ’ = φίλε) · also neut. nom. pl., elided (φίλ’ = φίλα): ’dear’, predicate (τὰ φίλ’ ἔσκε ’were dear’)
__broaden__.φίλαι: φίλος — dear, beloved; fem. voc. pl., used substantivally: ’friends’ (of the serving-women) · also fem. nom. pl., predicate adj.: ’dear’ (νῆες … φίλαι ἦσαν)
__broaden__.ἀλόχου: ἄλοχος — wife; fem. gen. sg., with πρός · also fem. gen. sg. as object of πειράω (+ gen.): ’of your wife’ (σῆς ἀλόχου πειρήσεαι ’you will make trial of your wife’) · also fem. gen. sg., with ἐκ: ’of a wedded wife’ (ἐξ ἀλόχου ’by a wife’)
__broaden__.ἄγον: ἄγω — lead, bring, take along; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγον): ’I took along’ · also impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, with ἐκ in tmesis (ἐκ … ἄγον = ἐξῆγον): ’they led out, carried off’
__broaden__.ἔα: ἐάω — let be, allow, leave alone; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’leave alone!’ · also εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν): ’I was’ (τοῖος ἔα ’such I was’)
__broaden__.ἑλών: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’picking out, choosing’ · also ’taking hold of, seizing’ (γούναθ’ ἑλών ’grasping the knees’)
__broaden__.ῥέζειν: ῥέζω — do, perform, sacrifice; pres. inf., used as an imperative · also pres. inf. of purpose: ’to sacrifice’
__broaden__.βάλεν: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, in tmesis with ἀμφί: ’threw about’ · also in tmesis with ἐπί (βάλεν δ’ ἐπὶ ... ἑκάστῳ = ἐπέβαλε): ’threw over, cast upon’ · also in tmesis with παρά (πάρ … βάλεν = παρέβαλε): ’threw beside, set before’ · also without tmesis, with κε, unreal past: ’would have hurled’ (κε … βάλεν … ποτὶ πέτρας ’would have dashed her against the rocks’) · also in tmesis with ἐν (ἐν … βάλεν = ἐνέβαλε): ’cast into, sent upon’ (φύζαν … βάλεν ’sent panic upon’)
__broaden__.τήν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg., resumptive: ’whom’ · also demonstrative, fem. acc. sg., resuming an earlier noun: ’her’ (τήν … ῥέξω ’her I will sacrifice’) · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὀιζυῖ πολλῇ, τήν μοι ἐπῶρσε ’great misery, which he roused for me’) · also demonstrative with a noun and adjective: ’that’ (τήν γε στυγερὴν ὁδόν ’that hateful journey’)
